messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Kannada)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | l'ora | “the hour” (temporal noun) | ಗಂಟೆ (within “ಸಮಯದ ಗಂಟೆ”) | hour | OK | | del | genitive “of” linking *tempo* to *ora* | ಸಮಯದ (genitive suffix “‑ದ”) | of time | OK | | tempo | “time” | ಸಮಯ | time | OK | | e | coordinating “and” | ಮತ್ತು | and | OK | | la (1) | definite article, fem. sing. | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | dolce | adjective “sweet” | ಮಧುರ | sweet | OK | | stagione | noun “season” | ಋತು | season | OK | | ma | coordinating “but” | ಆದರೆ | but | OK | | non (1) | first negation in “non sì” (part of “not so”) | ಇಷ್ಟು (part of “ಇಷ್ಟು ಆಗಿರದಂತೆ”) | so (negated) | OK | | sì | degree adverb “so” | ಇಷ್ಟು (same phrase) | so | OK | | che (1) | subordinator “that” introducing clause | ಆಗಿರದಂತೆ (clausal marker) | that … not | OK | | paura | noun “fear” | ಭಯ | fear | OK | | non (2) | second negation, negates the verb “give” | ನೀಡದಂತೆ (part of phrase) | not give | OK | | mi | indirect object “to me” | ನನಗೆ | to me | OK | | desse | subjunctive “give” (potential causation) | ನೀಡದಂತೆ (verb) | give (negated) | OK | | la (2) | article before *vista* | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | vista | noun “sight, view” | ದೃಶ್ಯವು | sight | OK | | che (2) | relative pronoun “which” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | m'apparve | verb phrase “appeared to me” | ನನಗೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು | appeared to me | OK | | d'un | preposition + indefinite article “of a” | ಸಿಂಹದ (genitive) | of the lion | OK | | leone. | noun “lion” | ಸಿಂಹ | lion | OK |
### Summary of Issues - **UNNECESSARY**: - `la` (both occurrences) – Italian definite article has no direct counterpart in Kannada. - `che` (second occurrence) – relative pronoun omitted because Kannada embeds the relative meaning in the clause.
- **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.
All other source tokens are represented with appropriate Kannada equivalents, preserving the meaning of the reference translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 43: - Original: ಸಮಯದ ಗಂಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಧುರ ಋತು; - Issue: none - Corrected: ಸಮಯದ ಗಂಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಧುರ ಋತು; - Line 44: - Original: ಆದರೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಆಗಿರದಂತೆ ಭಯ ನನಗೆ ನೀಡದಂತೆ - Issue: none - Corrected: ಆದರೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಆಗಿರದಂತೆ ಭಯ ನನಗೆ ನೀಡದಂತೆ - Line 45: - Original: ಸಿಂಹದ ದೃಶ್ಯವು ನನಗೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು. - Issue: none - Corrected: ಸಿಂಹದ ದೃಶ್ಯವು ನನಗೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
``` ಸಮಯದ ಗಂಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಧುರ ಋತು; ಆದರೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಆಗಿರದಂತೆ ಭಯ ನನಗೆ ನೀಡದಂತೆ ಸಿಂಹದ ದೃಶ್ಯವು ನನಗೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು. ```
